SUBJ_ALL_CAPS: The subject uses too many capitals.
MANY_EXCLAMATIONS: The message uses repeated exclamation marks.
MIME_HTML_ONLY: The message needs a readable plain-text version.
MISSING_MID: The email service did not add a message identifier.
MISSING_DATE: The email service did not add a date.
R_SPF_FAIL: The sending address did not pass an identity check.
R_DKIM_REJECT: The message signature did not pass its identity check.
DMARC_POLICY_REJECT: The message did not pass the sender's identity policy.
